pages.t: Press B to open this book (Options > Mods to change the key).
Every ore has a mining level. A pickaxe mines anything up to its own level, and each ore needs the pickaxe of the tier before it.
Wood is tier 0 and stone tier 1. Tin needs a stone pickaxe, copper is tier 5, iron 8, diamond 20, netherite 25, and the climb ends at genesium, tier 50.
Hover a tool to see its level. Look at an ore to see the level it needs, and whether what you hold is enough (the Mining Tooltips mod).
Made on a 3x3 from 4 crafting tables, 4 logs and a stone pickaxe.
Anything made only from early things (wood, stone, coal, sand, plants, mob drops) still crafts on a 3x3. Everything that takes later materials needs the 5x5 table and about 2 to 3 times the material.
A log gives 2 planks, and 2 planks give 2 sticks.
JEI shows every recipe; its + button lays one out in the table. Each shift-click on the result crafts one. Items stay in the table when you close it.
Every tier has a pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, sword and armor. Most take the rarest gem below them, with the tier below as the handle.
Break 3x3. 4x durability; the hammer digs at 40% speed, the excavator 28%. Blocks above the tool's level, or far harder than the one you hit, stay.
All 5 tools plus 8 of the material: one tool that does every job, with 5x durability and every tool and weapon enchantment. Right-click makes paths, sneak-right-click tills.
